after.tests/test_notices.py:
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def make_mark(dayno, status, ident="s1"):
    return Mark(ident, date(2026, 9, dayno), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark(9, "absent"),
            make_mark(4, "present"),
            make_mark(2, "absent"),
        ]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace", text)
        self.assertIn("2 days", text)
        self.assertIn("2026-09-02, 2026-09-09", text)

    def test_other_student_marks(self):
        marks = [make_mark(2, "absent", "s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences(self):
        marks = [make_mark(2, "present")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
